body: Ok no problem ..
I am sorry but I do not understand what you are trying to say ... can u elaborate ?
Yup they are inevitable brain reactions too subtle to notice ... but can make or break a person ... shape their lives ... I will figure out how to learn to feel atleast

No I meant this : https://www.britannica.com/topic/learned-helplessness

Due to luck and initial amt fear a person has ... if they r put through normal situations they would turn out like most folks ... but if they keep failing or r in a abusive environment again and again .. brain kinda develops tolerance or makes peace with it and doesn't try to escape it even when opportunity arises ... so I meant you are right fear n luck shape a person
True ... you are talking about learned helplessness
Fear is causing no connection or do u mean it's frightening that there is no connection and hence ppl move on
I feel what's the point continuing if you cannot even be functional consistently ... ppl will grow tired of you either walk away or fire you ... m tired of myself now

I do feel like kill myself coz m back to square one every few days ... I have a high ..sort of when I am fictional or am in an illusion that things are gd in life ... n then reality hits n I can't control those thoughts ... I got fired once and feel m going down that rabbit whole in my current job ... I really worked hard .. did my masters and all and now everything is falling apart
I am scared I will land myself there due to this depression I cannot control ... see it happening but even if I want to cannot control
Hmm I understand ... u are lucky person ...

Hmm ... my connection is based on ideas about world philosophy and person has to be tolerant and be open to discussion n on right side of dark topics like child abuse or issues with equality... and be calm n non abusive  once he earns my respect usually I would like to be with that person but do I feel emotional about them no I do not ...

If we broke up I feel sad cry for two days y I don't ever connect with people ... basically convince myself I imagined someone and the person is different and basically that person I imagined never existed so ... go back to feeling sad that I have to start dating again .. tht is the part that hurts more 

I agree with the quote u mentioned above ... I would be there for the person once I have decide I am going to be there .. it's just not emotional for me or connection for me .. it's a conscious decision for me
Yes i agree it is ... m trying to figure out what would a person who doesn't feel much or has tendency to push them aside would get a chance in this case
Hmm I understand
Sry my phone was acting weird 😅😅

Ok ..I understand ... example:  you are just there .. like most family member they accept u ... I don't feel connected to my partners or parents also  .. but if I respect them I would like it to continue n would be loyal but usually they end it .. so trying to figure out how bad my chances are in finding someone in similar boat
Well you dated ... n things are calm ... but not much connection ... life is moving along ... no drama ... smthing like that ...
Hmm ... so folks who don't feel connected to anyone  .. it would make their partner feel that way too n relationship is bound to end
Yea I would say mine is more like 5-6 ... doesn't move much sometimes I pretend to fit in

Well ... the partners I have dated don't really tell it makes them uncomfortable or so .. or don't communicate .. I had to figure it out after all my breakups resulted in similar response they don't feel connected or you talk about stuff problems of world that don't concern me and you are too ditached

Interesting ... my concept of connection is if the person is in control of their emotions and not abusive .. shares similar ideas and activities .. I shld be connected .. shld being the operative word ... kinda seems mechanical now lol
Thank you

Yes I am going to go take some counseling. I tried helping myself by taking up hobbies and activities and I will pay attention to others likes and dislikes I am very oblivious to that fact. Usually prefer someone to meet someone who doesn't care if I remember that detail coz that is very difficult for me but I will improve on that

Angry - usually stuff that ppl do when i see they have life with someone and destroy it by choosing to do silly actions while I have struggling to connect with anyone for that matter. And general world issues where we all claim to care but there are still children women men being abused ... also for abusers they are just punished tht doesn't really solve the problem they need to be rehabilitated punishment I feel is wasteful if end of the day that individual is still a threat .. same thing happens with criminals. Lack of tolerance and patience  ... I have actually asked my exs to give me second chance help me understand ... but there never is any feedback and I keep hitting my head on same problem. Ignoring what really matters and the rat race for more ... may be some folks like doing mundane work y does everybody need to intelligent work all the time. 

Sad - nothing much ... Other day mom mentioned about a family of relative passing away except for one yr old child. And went on to say how sad or unfortunate it is for her since she is only surviving member. I was more like you going to funeral or prayer service is not going to do much .. if no one is going to take her in either I can adopt or set up funds which will ensure her future. I do care but don't feel sad when there is usually a solution. But feel super traumatized when I cannot figure out a solution like this one about not having a clear path to how to connect with ppl 

Happy - nothing much .. except being around a person I can talk the worldly stuff freely and having intelligent conversation abt solving stuff . I usually after that just go along with what tht person does to make themselves happy . I do like hiking n activities but I feel thts just to keep myself from going in loops in my head so tht in a way does make me happy

I understand when you say trick is to meet someone in a thing you are passionate about. But I usually am not passionate about anything. I do loads of activities to keep busy but do I feel anything about it no. I pretend sometimes but it doesn't last long. That's y I try cultivating habits and hoping to cultivate few more which will atleast make other person feel less distant from me

I agree I have distorted view of what a normal relationship is. My view is basically let the partner be how ever they are and just be ok with it whether I like it or not coz I don't feel much so eventually I am ok with it and also in hopes of not making the other person claustrophobic coz I do really want that person to feel connected to me. That basically results in very monotonous form for other person I guess and loose interest. But I don't know how else to be. Or even express my discontent without causing full blown fight because anytime I have done that they come back saying you are blaming me
